purpose: Deterministic union of static + preload + post-ready census entries. Identity is hashable; conflicts are surfaced.
mergeRules: Same identity across sources → single canonical entry with sources array.
Different identity, same delegation root → two entries, no collapse.
Conflict on identity values → CENSUS_CONFLICT, FAIL.
deterministicRequirements: Inputs sorted by (semanticTargetId, eventType, eventPhase, handlerFingerprint, delegationRootSemanticId).
Two runs on identical fixtures must produce identical hash.

postReady.rationale: Handlers installed after hydration (e.g. SolidJS createEffect) must be captured.
postReady.method: Playwright trace + TS Compiler API on TS/TSX/JS
